meta.title: CPI Airfare & Transport — eSankhyiki (MoSPI)
meta.source: eSankhyiki — Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI), Government of India
meta.purpose: Official CPI series relevant to SAFAR (Problem Statement 26056): a real-time, fixed-basket, hedonic Airfare Price Index (APIx) to augment the CPI 'Airfare' item (COICOP 07.3.3.1.2.01). The CPI currently measures air travel monthly via manual collection; SAFAR automates daily collection and back-tests against this series.

fields.index: CPI index value (base year = 100). NOTE: index levels are NOT comparable across base years.
fields.inflation_yoy_pct: Year-on-year inflation % — comparable across base years.
fields.imputation: Whether the cell was imputed (Y/N) in the 2024 base.
fields.status: MoSPI release status flag (F = final) in legacy bases.

coverage.base_2024: Latest CPI structure (COICOP 2018 aligned). Airfare item + parent class/division + all-items CPI, Rural/Urban/Combined, monthly (2025–present).

meta.attribution: Data published by MoSPI via eSankhyiki. Reuse should preserve dataset name, indicator, value, unit, reference period and source.
notes: The 2012-base airfare series has no observations for 2020-03, 2020-04 and 2020-05 — CPI field collection was suspended during the first COVID-19 lockdown and MoSPI did not release these months.
Index levels (base year = 100) are not comparable across the 2010/2012/2024 bases; only inflation_yoy_pct is directly comparable across bases.
